Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Siddhartha Singh, Advocate for 
the petitioners. 
Heard. 
Admit. 
Issue notices to the respondents 
fixing 17.05.2019.

for the petitioners and after perusal of 
the papers brought on record, as an 
interim measure, it is directed that till 
the next date of listing further 
proceedings of Execution Case No. 16 of 
2000, Kishan Lal Bobal through LRs. Vs. 
Darveshwar Prasad through LRs.

Civil Judge (Sr.Div.) Dehradun shall 
remain stayed. 
Stay application stands disposed of. 
Let a certified copy of the order be 
supplied to the counsel for the 
petitioners today itself on payment of 
usual charges. 
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.)
